subject: Audit-log ingestion bands, evidence delivery & pilot credit — proposal
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthstride.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logging: expected ingest & ask on pricing path and evidence cadence

Irene / Laura —

Thanks for the quick run earlier. To get procurement moving we need a clear commercial for audit-log retention/ingest costs and how you’ll handle evidence delivery for our SOC2-like review. A few specifics from our side:

- Expected average audit-log ingest: ~1.2 TB/day initially, ramping to ~3 TB/day over 9 months (csv attached).
- Retention required: 13 months with searchable indexes for the first 90 days, then cold retention.
- We need evidence bundles for quarterly internal audits for the first year (logs + attestation artifacts).

Primary asks: 1) a tiered ingest pricing proposal (ingest bands + overage), 2) onboarding/evidence delivery fee options (one-time vs annual), and 3) KMS vs HSM incremental pricing and whether you can amortize onboarding costs into credits.

Procurement would like a single PDF and SOW for legal review by next week if possible. Attaching a CSV with our sample volumes.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Ops, HealthStride
attachments: healthstride_audit_volume.csv
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthstride.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging: expected ingest & ask on pricing path and evidence cadence

Samir —

Thanks for the volume sample — that helps a lot. Looping Ben to sketch a concrete commercial and Laura on renewals/bill cadence. Initial thinking (high level):

- Ingest-based bands (monthly): Tier A: 0–30 TB/mo, Tier B: 30–90 TB/mo, Tier C: 90–300 TB/mo; per-GB rates decline by band.
- Overage: capped per-request to avoid surprise bursts; we can offer a 45% discount on list overage for the first 90 days of ramp.
- Evidence delivery: one-time evidence pack for the initial audit (PDF + searchable index) vs subscription for quarterly bundles. We can offer a one-time evidence onboarding fee OR convert that fee into a credit applied over N months if you take a 12-month commit.
- HSM: monthly seat vs per-GB KMS premium — seat pricing tends to be preferable for predictable high-throughput use.

Ben — can you draft a pricing table and a 1-page SOW outline? Samir — can you confirm the target PO date and whether HealthStride prefers upfront invoicing or monthly billing?

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthstride.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging: expected ingest & ask on pricing path and evidence cadence

Samir / Team —

Attached is a draft commercial approach and a simple banded pricing table for the numbers you sent. Key points:

- Proposed bands (monthly ingest): 0–30 TB @ $0.012/GB, 30–90 TB @ $0.0085/GB, 90–300 TB @ $0.0055/GB.
- Pilot concession: first 3 months at 25% off the blended price (applied as a credit on the first invoice).
- Onboarding/evidence options: one-time evidence pack = $28,000 (includes export, indexing, and one curated evidence bundle). Or convert to a 12-month amortized credit at $2,333/mo if you take a 12-mo committed volume.
- HSM add-on: $3,500/mo per dedicated HSM cluster node OR KMS envelope encryption at +12% on base ingest costs.
- SLA credits: for the compliance bundle (evidence + HSM), we’ll include a 99.5% uptime SLA on the audit-log search path with financial credits up to 3% of monthly recurring charges for qualifying incidents.

I’ve attached the pricing table and a SOW stub. If the PO is monthly we can apply the pilot concession as a credit; if upfront 12-month commit we can lower the per-GB by an additional 10%.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_playbook_v1.pdf, SOW-v0.3.docx

Ben
VP, Product Pricing — Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthstride.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthstride.com
Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging: expected ingest & ask on pricing path and evidence cadence

Thanks Ben — that’s a good start. A couple of clarifying questions before we take this to procurement: 

- Overages: You mentioned a cap per-request to avoid surprise bursts — can you define the cap (GB/day) and the mechanism for automatic throttling vs billing? We need a hard cap option for the pilot.
- Evidence cadence: we will definitely need quarterly bundles; can the evidence subscription be reduced for Q3/Q4 if we’re out of pilot? In other words, can you make evidence billing flexible rather than fixed?
- HSM: we want to avoid a large upfront seat commitment; can you do a 90-day trial of a single HSM node with usage-based billing after that?

Procurement’s preference is monthly invoicing with net-45 payment terms. Target PO date: 2028-04-15.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Samir
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthstride.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Apr 2028 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging: expected ingest & ask on pricing path and evidence cadence

Samir —

Love the pragmatic asks. Concrete clarifications and a revised offer: 

- Hard cap option: we can set a pilot hard-cap of 5 TB/day (auto-throttle) with a safety buffer alert at 4 TB/day. If the cap is hit, requests are throttled; you’ll only be billed for the ingested bytes up to the cap. For production we recommend no hard cap but a negotiated overage guardrail with alerting.

- Evidence subscription flexibility: yes — quarterly evidence bundles can be purchased on-demand (one-off invoices) or on a subscription. For pilots we’ll do a 50% discount on the per-bundle price for the first 4 bundles (first year). After pilot, you can move to on-demand.

- HSM trial: we can provision a single HSM node for a 90-day trial at no seat charge; after trial, billing converts to $2,800/mo for that node for the first 12 months if you continue.

- Additional concession: to help procurement sign-off we’ll apply the pilot concession as follows: 1) 25% credit on invoice for first 3 months, 2) evidence onboarding fee reduced to $14k if you sign PO by 2028-04-15, OR convert that $14k to a monthly credit over 6 months for monthly billing.

Next steps: I’ll prepare a short commercial summary + updated SOW reflecting the hard-cap, trial HSM, and evidence discount. Can you confirm acceptance of net-45 terms and PO date?

Thanks —
Tessa
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthstride.com>, procurement@healthstride.com
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging: expected ingest & ask on pricing path and evidence cadence

Samir / Procurement —

Thanks — summarizing agreed commercial points so procurement has a single doc for review: 

1) Pricing bands (monthly ingest): 0–30 TB @ $0.012/GB; 30–90 TB @ $0.0085/GB; 90–300 TB @ $0.0055/GB.
2) Pilot concessions: 25% credit applied to invoices for months 1–3.
3) Hard-cap: pilot hard-cap at 5 TB/day with auto-throttle; no billing beyond cap unless HealthStride requests removal.
4) Evidence: onboarding pack discounted to $14,000 if PO signed by 2028-04-15; quarterly evidence bundles 50% off for first year (on-demand available).
5) HSM: 90-day no-seat-charge trial for one node; if continued, $2,800/mo for that node for months 4–15 (first-year concession). KMS option remains +12% uplift.
6) SLA: 99.5% search-path uptime for compliance bundle; credits up to 3% MRC for qualifying incidents.
7) Billing: monthly invoicing, net-45 payment terms. PO target date: 2028-04-15.

Next steps from our side: Tessa will upload an updated SOW and one-page commercial summary to the HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign for acceptance. Please confirm whether procurement wants the evidence pack invoiced upfront or amortized as credits.

I’ll hold the onboarding discount until COB 2028-04-15. Let me know if you need any edits for legal.

Best,
Irene
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
